data.title: Anthropic and OpenAI sound the alarm on AI safety - and seek to shape how it’s controlled
data.description: The CEOs of Anthropic and OpenAI recently declared America’s cutting-edge models are so powerful, they’re dangerous, and need to be regulated and independently tested before being released.
data.author: Garance Burke The Associated Press
